query:
SELECT 
  (SELECT SUM(liters_purchased)/100 FROM fuel_purchases WHERE gallon_number = 1) as comprado_galao1,
  (SELECT SUM(liters)/100 FROM fuel_records WHERE gallon_number = 1) as abastecido_galao1,
  (SELECT SUM(liters_purchased)/100 FROM fuel_purchases WHERE gallon_number = 1) - (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(liters)/100, 0) FROM fuel_records WHERE gallon_number = 1) as estoque_galao1;
